Summary: ESMA’s final report presents revised CSDR guidelines on arrangements, communication procedures and messaging protocols for investment firms and their professional clients, including the use of electronic and international open standards.
title: Final report on the revised CSDR Guidelines on standardised procedures and messaging protocols used between investment firms and their professional clients

Summary: The EBA consults on three draft regulatory technical standards covering calculation of credit-institution thresholds for investment firms, information for monitoring those thresholds, and factors competent authorities should consider when granting a waiver.
title: Consultation Paper on draft RTS on reclassification of investment firms as credit institutions

Issuer: Autoridade de Supervisão de Seguros e Fundos de Pensões (ASF)
Summary: The ASF is consulting on a draft regulatory standard setting quarterly capital adjustment indices for fire and natural elements insurance policies beginning or renewing in the first quarter of 2027.
title: Consulta Pública n.º 6/2026 Projeto de Norma Regulamentar que estabelece os índices trimestrais de atualização de capitais para as apólices do ramo "Incêndio e elementos da natureza" com início ou vencimento no primeiro trimestre de 2027

Summary: This instruction amends Instruction No. 11/2025, which regulates the Interbank Clearing System (SICOI).
title: Instrução (Histórico) n.º 9/2026

Issuer: Comissão do Mercado de Valores Mobiliários (CMVM)
Summary: CMVM Circular 006/2026 concerns the Financial Action Task Force (GAFI) and the prevention and combating of money laundering and terrorist financing.
title: Circular 006/2026 - GAFI - Prevenção e Combate ao Branqueamento de Capitais e ao Financiamento do Terrorismo

Summary: This instruction, in force from 27 August 2026, revokes Instruction No. 28/2018 and concerns prudential standards for credit institutions headquartered in Portugal.
title: Instrução (Histórico) n.º 7/2026

Issuer: Autoridade de Supervisão de Seguros e Fundos de Pensões (ASF)
Summary: The ASF is consulting on a draft regulatory standard to align the uniform crop insurance policy for fruit and horticultural products in the Azores with the regional regime established by Portaria No. 95/2026.
title: Consulta Pública n.º 7/2026 - Projeto de norma regulamentar que altera a Apólice Uniforme do Seguro de Colheitas de Frutas e Produtos Hortícolas para a Região Autónoma dos Açores

Issuer: Autoridade de Supervisão de Seguros e Fundos de Pensões (ASF)
Summary: This regulation introduces new reporting duties to the ASF on ICT third-party arrangements, severe ICT incidents, significant cyber threats, ICT risk management and cyberattack information-sharing, while simplifying existing incident reporting requirements and repealing overlapping rules.
title: Norma Regulamentar n.º 6/2026-R, de 20 de outubro - Reporte à ASF para supervisão da resiliência operacional digital

Summary: ESMA’s final report provides technical advice on selected Taxonomy Disclosure Delegated Act KPIs, including revisions to the OpEx KPI, voluntary OpEx reporting by financial undertakings, group reporting and other possible simplifications.
title: Final report on Technical Advice on selected KPIs under the Taxonomy Disclosures Delegated Act

Summary: ESMA consults on draft regulatory and implementing technical standards specifying the reporting framework for clearing activity at recognised third-country central counterparties under EMIR Article 7d.
title: Consultation on the reporting framework under EMIR for clearing activity at recognised third-country CCPs
